## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and the current-to-target delta.

## Evidence

- [ ] Relevant unit and contract tests pass.
- [ ] Type, lint and formatting checks pass.
- [ ] Integration/E2E, visual, accessibility or load evidence is attached when relevant.
- [ ] No test was presented as run when it was skipped; skipped checks have a reason and gate.

## Layer or provider integration (if applicable)

- [ ] Versioned manifest, query/100-feature budget and cancellation.
- [ ] Loading, empty, partial, error and provider-outage states.
- [ ] Filters, legend, provider-neutral detail/actions and accessible non-map alternative.
- [ ] Permissions, private-data boundary, AI exposure and entitlement policy.
- [ ] Fixture/contract tests, health/SLO owner and disable/rollback path.
- [ ] No provider secret or untrusted extension JavaScript reaches the client.

## Release safety

- [ ] Migration is additive/idempotent or has an approved expand/migrate/contract plan.
- [ ] Feature flag, owner, removal date and rollback are documented.
- [ ] Security, privacy, dependency and bundle impact were reviewed.
- [ ] Traceability and release/upgrade documentation were updated.

If a box does not apply, say why instead of checking it silently.
